verdict.rationale: Remote documents a REST API (e.g., `POST /v1/employments`), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The llms.txt docs index and the per-country dynamic JSON schemas for employment fields are adjacent artifacts, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.
